card.name: Space before patient counts in studies
card.fires_on: The space right after 'of' or 'over' just before a large number of study participants, as in 'trials of <<space>>11,000 patients'. It appears in descriptions of pooled trials and surveys.

modes.label: Sample size after of/over
modes.description: The space before a number of patients or adults after 'of' or 'over' in a study summary.

modes.label: Number after a colon or table label
modes.description: The space or label before a count in a list or table.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens show no clear link to this pattern, so the output effect is unclear.
